name: TableOfContents
description: Indexes a long page and marks the section currently in view.

children.description: TableOfContents.Item or TableOfContents.Group elements; none renders nothing

title.description: The title above the list; null shows none

when: Docs, articles, and other long reads
whenNot: Pages with one or two sections
guidelines: Drive the active item from an IntersectionObserver scroll spy
Group nests items one level deeper under a labelled header that folds at once
Pass collapsible={false} for a header that is only a label
Item targetId must match the real heading id
Items smooth-scroll — call preventDefault() in onClick to take over
Group is uncontrolled and open by default; pass open and onOpenChange to drive it
Pass title={null} to show no title
accessibility: Uses <nav aria-label="Table of contents"> for landmark navigation
The section in view is marked with aria-current="location"
Items are links; in-page links smooth-scroll unless reduced motion is requested
A folding group header is a real <button> with aria-expanded; its items sit in a nested list

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Top-level sections, with one group nested a level deeper.

examples.name: Nested Groups
examples.description: Groups fold at once; one starts closed.
examples.code: All 3}> Button Card Input Features Plans

examples.name: With Active Item
examples.description: The section in view takes the selection wash.

examples.name: Custom Title
examples.description: Renames the title above the list.
examples.code:
<TableOfContents title="Contents">
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="chapter-1">Chapter 1: The beginning</TableOfContents.Item>
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="chapter-2">Chapter 2: The middle</TableOfContents.Item>
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="chapter-3">Chapter 3: The end</TableOfContents.Item>
</TableOfContents>

examples.name: No Title
examples.code:
<TableOfContents title={null}>
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="section-a">Section A</TableOfContents.Item>
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="section-b" active>Section B</TableOfContents.Item>
  <TableOfContents.Item targetId="section-c">Section C</TableOfContents.Item>
</TableOfContents>

relations.note: Breadcrumbs show hierarchy, TOC shows page sections
Sidebar for site nav, TOC for in-page nav
Tabs for switching views, TOC for scrolling to sections

propsSummary: title: node - visible heading (default "On this page"); null shows none
label: string - aria-label for nav landmark
TableOfContents.Item targetId: string - heading id to scroll to
TableOfContents.Item active: boolean - the section in view (selection wash)
TableOfContents.Item leading/trailing: node - optional adornments before/after the label
TableOfContents.Group label: node - header text for the group; its items nest one level deeper
TableOfContents.Group defaultOpen / open / onOpenChange - uncontrolled or controlled open state (default open)
TableOfContents.Group collapsible: boolean - false renders a static label (default true)
TableOfContents.Group trailing/leading: node - optional adornments on the group header row
Forwards standard nav/anchor DOM props; TableOfContents.Item onClick can prevent default smooth scroll

commonPatterns: <TableOfContents>{groups.map(g => <TableOfContents.Group key={g.label} label={g.label} trailing={g.count}>{g.items.map(i => <TableOfContents.Item key={i.id} targetId={i.id} active={activeId === i.id}>{i.label}</TableOfContents.Item>)}</TableOfContents.Group>)}</TableOfContents>
